skills.name: expressive-voice
skills.description: Create expressive, character-consistent speech with user-defined voices, performance directions and reusable reference audio. Use for narration, animated dialogue, lessons and poetry, including adapting the Yuanri student voice workflow to new roles.

skills.name: photo-to-3d-diorama
skills.description: Generate complete reusable 3D diorama scenes from uploaded photos or artwork, preserving source elements with selectable styles and multi-angle inspection. Use for photo-to-3D assets rather than a static image gallery.
